templates.template: APM business metrics by ClickHouse HTTP
templates.name: APM business metrics by ClickHouse HTTP
templates.description:
Version 1.0. Business metrics (KPIs) of one application from its OpenTelemetry metrics in ClickHouse (otel_metrics_sum, otel_metrics_gauge, otel_metrics_histogram), through the ClickHouse HTTP interface: orders by store, reservations by hotel, revenue, carts abandoned... whatever counters, gauges and histograms the application sends.

Link it to the host of the application (apm-<namespace>, see scripts/zabbix-apm-app.py add --kpi) and set {$APM.NAMESPACE}. Each metric gets an item with its value per minute, plus the totals of the last hour, today and yesterday; each value of its attributes (store, hotel, currency...) gets the same items. One query per minute; everything else is dependent or calculated.

Docs: https://github.com/SimonLexRS/zabbix-apm-dashboard/blob/main/docs/business-kpis.md

items.name: APM business metrics: Get
items.posts:
WITH
    toDateTime(toStartOfMinute(now()) - {delay:UInt32}) AS t1,
    t1 - 60 AS t0,
    t1 - {window:UInt32} * 60 AS tw,
    -- Quotes and backslashes are removed from names: they would break the item keys and JSONPath filters.
    (x -> replaceRegexpAll(x, '[''"\\\\]', '')) AS clean
SELECT
    service, metric, kind, any(unit) AS unit, any(description) AS description, dim.1 AS dim_key, dim.2 AS dim_value,
    round(sum(value), 6) AS value, round(sum(cnt), 6) AS count, round(sum(total), 6) AS sum, round(sum(win), 6) AS window_total
FROM
(
    SELECT
        service, metric, kind, unit, description, attrs,
        arrayMap(p -> p.1, pts) AS ts,
        arrayMap(p -> p.2, pts) AS vs,
        arrayMap(p -> p.3, pts) AS ss,
        arrayMap(p -> p.4, pts) AS starts,
        -- Increase of a cumulative series in [t0, t1): differences between consecutive points, a reset (lower value)
        -- counts the new value, and a series that starts inside the window counts its first value.
        arrayMap((v, pv, st, i) -> if(i = 1, if(st >= tw, v, 0), if(v >= pv, v - pv, v)),
            vs, arrayPopBack(arrayPushFront(vs, 0)), starts, arrayEnumerate(vs)) AS dv,
        arrayMap((v, pv, st, i) -> if(i = 1, if(st >= tw, v, 0), if(v >= pv, v - pv, v)),
            ss, arrayPopBack(arrayPushFront(ss, 0)), starts, arrayEnumerate(ss)) AS ds,
        arraySum(arrayMap((d, t) -> if(t >= t0, d, 0), if(delta, vs, dv), ts)) AS inc_v,
        arraySum(arrayMap((d, t) -> if(t >= t0, d, 0), if(delta, ss, ds), ts)) AS inc_s,
        -- Current values count only for instances that reported in the last 5 minutes (not one that stopped).
        if(kind IN ('gauge', 'updown'), if(ts[-1] >= t1 - 300, vs[-1], 0), inc_v) AS value,
        if(kind = 'histogram', inc_v, 0) AS cnt,
        if(kind = 'histogram', inc_s, 0) AS total,
        if(kind IN ('gauge', 'updown'), arrayMax(vs), arraySum(if(delta, vs, dv))) AS win
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            clean(ServiceName) AS service, clean(MetricName) AS metric, kind, Attributes AS attrs,
            if(match(any(MetricUnit), '^([{].*[}]|1)$'), '', any(MetricUnit)) AS unit, any(MetricDescription) AS description, max(temporality = 1) AS delta,
            arraySort(p -> p.1, groupArray((TimeUnix, v, s, StartTimeUnix))) AS pts
        FROM
        (
            SELECT ServiceName, MetricName, MetricUnit, MetricDescription, Attributes, ResourceAttributes,
                   TimeUnix, StartTimeUnix, Value AS v, 0 AS s, AggregationTemporality AS temporality,
                   if(IsMonotonic, 'counter', 'updown') AS kind
            FROM {db:Identifier}.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE TimeUnix >= tw AND TimeUnix < t1
            UNION ALL
            SELECT ServiceName, MetricName, MetricUnit, MetricDescription, Attributes, ResourceAttributes,
                   TimeUnix, StartTimeUnix, Value, 0, 0, 'gauge'
            FROM {db:Identifier}.otel_metrics_gauge
            WHERE TimeUnix >= tw AND TimeUnix < t1
            UNION ALL
            SELECT ServiceName, MetricName, MetricUnit, MetricDescription, Attributes, ResourceAttributes,
                   TimeUnix, StartTimeUnix, toFloat64(Count), Sum, AggregationTemporality, 'histogram'
            FROM {db:Identifier}.otel_metrics_histogram
            WHERE TimeUnix >= tw AND TimeUnix < t1
        )
        WHERE ResourceAttributes['service.namespace'] = {ns:String}
          AND match(MetricName, {metric_matches:String})
          AND ({metric_not_matches:String} = '' OR NOT match(MetricName, {metric_not_matches:String}))
        GROUP BY ServiceName, MetricName, kind, attrs, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']
    )
)
ARRAY JOIN arrayConcat([('', '')], arrayMap(k -> (clean(k), clean(attrs[k])),
    arrayFilter(k -> {dim_not_matches:String} = '' OR NOT match(k, {dim_not_matches:String}), mapKeys(attrs)))) AS dim
GROUP BY service, metric, kind, dim
ORDER BY dim_key != '', service, metric, dim_key, window_total DESC
LIMIT {values_limit:UInt32} BY service, metric, kind, dim_key
LIMIT {limit:UInt32}
FORMAT JSON
SETTINGS output_format_json_quote_64bit_integers = 0
items.description: Business metrics of the application in the last closed minute: one row per metric and one per value of each attribute. The discovery rules and the KPI items are dependent on this item.

items.name: APM business metrics: Rows
items.description: Rows returned by the query: business metrics plus their attribute values. It stops receiving values when ClickHouse cannot be queried.

triggers.expression: nodata(/APM business metrics by ClickHouse HTTP/apm.kpi.rows,10m)=1
triggers.name: APM business metrics: no data from ClickHouse
triggers.event_name: APM business metrics: the ClickHouse query has returned nothing for 10 minutes
triggers.description: Check {$CH.URL}, {$CH.USER} and {$CH.PASSWORD}, and the Latest data of the item "APM business metrics: Get" (its error).

discovery_rules.name: APM business metrics discovery
discovery_rules.description: Business metrics of the application seen in the last {$APM.KPI.DISCOVERY.WINDOW} minutes: every OpenTelemetry counter, up-down counter, gauge and histogram matching {$APM.KPI.METRIC.MATCHES} and not {$APM.KPI.METRIC.NOT_MATCHES}.

item_prototypes.name: KPI {#METRIC} ({#SERVICE}): {#LABEL}
item_prototypes.description: {#DESCRIPTION}. OpenTelemetry metric {#METRIC} ({#KIND}) of service {#SERVICE}. Counter: increase in each minute. Histogram: number of measurements in each minute. Up-down counter or gauge: current value. Sum its history over a period for the total of that period (e.g. a day), or read the "last hour", "today" and "yesterday" items.

item_prototypes.name: KPI {#METRIC} ({#SERVICE}): last hour
item_prototypes.description: {#DESCRIPTION}: total of the last 60 minutes (counters and histograms).

item_prototypes.name: KPI {#METRIC} ({#SERVICE}): per hour
item_prototypes.description: {#DESCRIPTION}: total of the previous clock hour, stored at minute 5 of the next one. One value per hour: sum them for a period of several hours or days.

item_prototypes.name: KPI {#METRIC} ({#SERVICE}): today
item_prototypes.description: {#DESCRIPTION}: total since 00:00 today, in the time zone of the Zabbix server.

item_prototypes.name: KPI {#METRIC} ({#SERVICE}): yesterday
item_prototypes.description: {#DESCRIPTION}: total of yesterday, in the time zone of the Zabbix server.

item_prototypes.name: KPI {#METRIC} ({#SERVICE}): sum per minute
item_prototypes.description: {#DESCRIPTION}: sum of the measurements in each minute (e.g. the amount of the orders). Sum its history over a period for the total of that period (e.g. a day), or read the "last hour", "today" and "yesterday" items.

item_prototypes.name: KPI {#METRIC} ({#SERVICE}): sum today
item_prototypes.description: {#DESCRIPTION}: sum of the measurements since 00:00 today.

item_prototypes.name: KPI {#METRIC} ({#SERVICE}): average last hour
item_prototypes.description: {#DESCRIPTION}: average measurement of the last 60 minutes (e.g. the average order amount).

overrides.name: Only histograms have a sum and an average

discovery_rules.name: APM business metric values discovery
discovery_rules.description: One set of items per value of each attribute of a business metric (e.g. orders by shop.store = Centro), up to {$APM.KPI.VALUES.LIMIT} values per attribute. Attribute keys matching {$APM.KPI.DIMENSION.NOT_MATCHES} are not broken down.

macros.description: Seconds the query waits for a minute to be complete before measuring it (export interval of the applications plus the batching of the collector). The default fits a 60 s export interval.
Regex: attribute keys that are not broken down into their own items (identifiers and other keys with too many values).
Minutes: metrics and attribute values seen within this window are discovered, and report 0 in the minutes without activity.
Maximum number of rows (metrics plus attribute values) returned by the query.
Regex: metrics to discover, e.g. ^(shop|hotel)\. to keep only your own.
Regex: metrics to ignore. By default the runtime, HTTP, database and SDK metrics of the OpenTelemetry instrumentation, which are not business metrics.
Maximum number of values per attribute and metric (the busiest in the discovery window). The others are still counted in the total of the metric.
Application of this host: the service.namespace resource attribute its services send. Required. scripts/zabbix-apm-app.py add --kpi sets it.
Regex: services whose metrics are discovered.
Regex: services whose metrics are ignored.
ClickHouse database with the APM tables.
ClickHouse HTTP interface URL, reachable from the Zabbix server or proxy.
